INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_DIALOGUE.title: Play special card dialogue
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_DIALOGUE.hover.de: [gold]When disabled:[/gold] dialogue bubbles triggered by Indomitable card presentations will not be shown.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_SOUND_EFFECTS.hov: [gold]When disabled:[/gold] custom voice lines and sounds from Indomitable card presentations are muted, but the default animation sound can still play.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ISOLATE_SPECIAL_VOICE_: Separate special card voices by player

[gold]When enabled:[/gold] a player's next special card voice interrupts their own previous line, while different players' voices can overlap.
[gold]When disabled:[/gold] all Indomitable voices share one playback channel, so the next line interrupts the previous one.
This only changes what you hear on this device; it does not change teammates' settings.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_SPECIAL_CARD_ANIM:
[gold]When enabled:[/gold] Indomitable in specific outfits performs unique animations for certain cards.
[gold]When disabled:[/gold] normal animations play. Combat victory animations are unaffected.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_AIRCRAFT_FLIGHT_A:
[gold]When enabled:[/gold] carrier aircraft fly and release ordnance before attacking, following their aircraft type. Fast mode plays at twice the speed.
[gold]When disabled:[/gold] skips the flight.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_HYPNOTIZED_ANIMAT:
[gold]When enabled:[/gold] a special animation plays, if available, when a player's Hypnotized reaches 5 stacks and triggers.
This setting only affects animations, not the effects of Hypnotized.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-IDLE_ANIMATION_DELAY_S:
After standing idle continuously for this many seconds, Indomitable plays her slacking animation once. Any other animation, including the slacking, resets the timer; it restarts on returning to idle.
Set to 0 to disable automatic playback. Only affects this device.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_IDLE_ANIMATION_ON: Play idle animation on end-turn ping

[gold]When enabled:[/gold] a local or teammate end-turn ping plays the slacking animation once for the corresponding Indomitable.
Independent of the automatic delay. Only affects animations shown on this device.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_SPECIAL_LINE_ONCE: Play each card's special line once per combat

[gold]When enabled:[/gold] each card type's special dialogue and audio share one use per combat.
After that use, the same card type uses the default animation sound.
The limit resets when you enter or leave combat, including after loading a save.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LUCKY_BAG_RELIC_RULE.h:
[gold]Collect automatically[/gold]: receive the gift immediately.
[gold]Allow skipping and return[/gold]: skipped gifts remain available.
[gold]Allow skipping and destroy[/gold]: the gift is consumed without granting the relic or its effects.
Skipping still uses Lucky Bag's activation for this shop.
In multiplayer, the host's setting applies.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CONFIRM_VACATION_PROPO:
[gold]On:[/gold] Show a confirmation before submitting the change.
[gold]Off:[/gold] Clicking an eligible room submits the change immediately.
Only affects your local interface.
